name: store-management-server
description: Express API for the store management system

scripts.test:auth:login: npm run build && jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath dist/test/auth.test.js --testNamePattern="LOGIN-1|LOGIN-3 and LOGIN-4|LOGIN-5|unknown login fields|G3 rejects malformed JSON on POST /api/auth/login"
scripts.test:auth:logout: npm run build && jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath dist/test/auth.test.js --testNamePattern="LOGOUT-|G3 rejects malformed JSON on POST /api/auth/logout"
scripts.test:auth:me:get: npm run build && jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath dist/test/auth.test.js --testNamePattern="LOGIN-2|G1 rejects GET /api/auth/me|G1 rejects an expired session|G3 rejects malformed JSON on GET /api/auth/me"
scripts.test:auth:me:patch: npm run build && jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath dist/test/auth.test.js --testNamePattern="ACCOUNT-|G1 rejects PATCH /api/auth/me|G3 rejects malformed JSON on PATCH /api/auth/me"
scripts.test:products:create: npm run build && jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath dist/test/products.test.js --testNamePattern="G1 rejects post /api/products|G3 rejects malformed JSON on POST /api/products|PROD-C"
scripts.test:products:update: npm run build && jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath dist/test/products.test.js --testNamePattern="G1 rejects patch /api/products|G2 rejects PATCH /api/products|G3 rejects malformed JSON when updating a product|PROD-U"
scripts.test:products:list: npm run build && jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath dist/test/products.test.js --testNamePattern="G1 rejects get /api/products|G3 rejects malformed JSON on GET /api/products|PROD-L"
scripts.test:products:delete: npm run build && jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath dist/test/products.test.js --testNamePattern="G1 rejects delete /api/products|G2 rejects DELETE /api/products|G3 rejects malformed JSON on DELETE /api/products|PROD-D"
scripts.test:checkout:create: npm run build && jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath dist/test/checkout.test.js --testNamePattern="G1 rejects checkout|G3 rejects malformed JSON|CO-"
scripts.test:sales:list: npm run build && jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath dist/test/sales.test.js --testNamePattern="G1 rejects sales requests|G3 rejects malformed JSON on GET /api/sales|SALES-"
